kernel: xpsloss.effective_cross_section_depth_averaged (public M3a API), the only package function called; the shared point value itself is outside the scope of the comparison

method.areas: window areas extrapolated separately over the whole window; w_n = m^n A_j A_13a^(n-1)
method.convolution: trapezoid rule on the exact overlap interval (full discrete convolution minus half of the two end terms; the one-point overlaps at n a and n b are exactly 0)
method.grid: T = a + i 2^-k eV, window ends, bin edges and primary edges on the grid
method.no_reference_rule: r != 0: f_r > 1.25e-5; unreachable regions are exact zeros with u_r = 0
method.regions: trapezoid rule with a positive weight vector per region (difference of the cumulative distribution as one local sum); binned primary: trapezoid rule over E' on the same grid
method.rounding_factor: (8 M + 64) 2^-53, M = finest intervals of the window

X01_wrong_answer_vs_RB1_width.wrong_model: C_n = K_total * K_total^(*(n-1)) (the repeated kernel is total instead of term_13a)
